title: Altered mRNA transport and local translation in iNeurons with RNA binding protein knockdown
authors: Rachael Dargan; Alla Mikheenko; Nicholas L. Johnson; Benjamin Packer; Ziyi Li; Emma J. Craig; Stephanie L. Sarbanes; Colleen Bereda; Puja R. Mehta; Matthew Keuss; Mike A. Nalls; Yue A. Qi; Cory A. Weller; Pietro Fratta; Veronica H. Ryan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究神经元中RNA结合蛋白敲低对mRNA转运和局部翻译的影响，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neurons rely on mRNA transport and local translation to facilitate rapid protein synthesis in processes far from the cell body. These processes allow precise spatial and temporal control of translation and are mediated by RNA binding proteins (RBPs), including those known to be associated with neurodegenerative diseases. Here, we use proteomics, transcriptomics, and microscopy to investigate the impact of RBP knockdown on mRNA transport and local translation in iPSC-derived neurons. We find thousands of transcripts enriched in neurites and that many of these transcripts are locally translated, possibly due to the shorter length of transcripts in neurites. Loss of frontotemporal dementia/amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (FTD/ALS)-associated RBPs TDP- 43 and hnRNPA1 lead to distinct alterations in the neuritic proteome and transcriptome. TDP-43 knockdown (KD) leads to increased neuritic mRNA and translation. In contrast, hnRNPA1 leads to increased neuritic mRNA, but not translation, and more moderate effects on local mRNA profiles, possibly due to compensation by hnRNPA3. These results highlight the crucial role of FTD/ALS-associated RBPs in mRNA transport and local translation in neurons and the importance of these processes in neuron health and disease.
abstract_zh: 神经元依赖mRNA运输和局部翻译，以在远离细胞体的过程中促进快速蛋白质合成。这些过程允许对翻译进行精确的时空控制，并由RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）介导，其中包括已知与神经退行性疾病相关的蛋白。在此，我们利用蛋白质组学、转录组学和显微镜技术，研究RBP敲低对iPSC衍生神经元中mRNA运输和局部翻译的影响。我们发现数千个转录本富集于神经突中，且其中许多转录本被局部翻译，这可能归因于神经突中转录本长度较短。额颞叶痴呆/肌萎缩侧索硬化症（FTD/ALS）相关RBPs TDP-43和hnRNPA1的缺失导致神经突蛋白质组和转录组发生显著改变。TDP-43敲低（KD）导致神经突mRNA和翻译增加。相比之下，hnRNPA1导致神经突mRNA增加，但翻译未增加，且对局部mRNA谱的影响较为温和，可能由于hnRNPA3的补偿作用。这些结果突显了FTD/ALS相关RBPs在神经元mRNA运输和局部翻译中的关键作用，以及这些过程在神经元健康和疾病中的重要性。
